dict.string: Septena shows upcoming events from your calendars on the Week dashboard.
Septena shows upcoming events from your calendars on the Week dashboard.
Septena reads your activity and recovery metrics (steps, exercise, VO2, HRV, resting heart rate) so the Activity tile can show them on the Week dashboard. Data stays on your device.
Septena saves your mood check-ins and nutrition entries (meals, macros, water) to HealthKit so they appear in the Health app alongside your other data. Data stays on your device.
Septena attaches photos to your meal entries and shows their thumbnails in your nutrition log. Photos stay on your device.
Septena imports tasks from your Reminders lists into the Inbox.
